Design, brand, admin and project support Brand · Digital · Interiors · Landscape · Operations

I take things from idea to finished: a brand, a website, a room, a garden, a product on a shelf. Trained in landscape architecture and interior design, and used to running the sourcing, suppliers and admin that get a project over the line. Alongside the design work I run the virtual assistance for a private practice, covering bookings, client communication, invoicing and payments, which keeps me sharp on the systems and the people side of a business.

Cape Town, Western Cape Available for freelance, contract or permanent
A little bit of everything, thoughtfully done.

My work sits somewhere between design, nature and the practical business of making things happen.

With a background in landscape architecture and interior design, I've worked across gardens, interiors, product development, branding, websites and content. I'm interested in how things look, how they work and how people experience them.

I enjoy the whole process, from the first sketch and material choices to sourcing, suppliers, installation and the finishing touches. Alongside my design work, I've managed the day-to-day running of a private psychology practice, so I'm just as comfortable with the admin, systems and people behind a project as I am with the creative work itself.

I'm curious by nature, happiest working across disciplines, and drawn to projects that are thoughtful, useful and made with care.
